proof_body:
by
  intro a b s t hne
  have hF : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc s t, HasDerivAt (fun x => Real.exp (a * x) * (a * Real.sin (b * x) - b * Real.cos (b * x)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) (Real.exp (a * x) * Real.sin (b * x)) x := by
    intro x _
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun y => a * y) a x := ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul a).congr_deriv (by ring)
    have hb : HasDerivAt (fun y => b * y) b x := ((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul b).congr_deriv (by ring)
    refine ((ha.exp.fun_mul ((hb.sin.const_mul a).fun_sub (hb.cos.const_mul b))).div_const _).congr_deriv ?_
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (a * x) * Real.sin (b * x)).intervalIntegrable s t)]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (a b s t : ℝ), a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 → (∫ x in s..t, Real.exp (a * x) * Real.sin (b * x)) = (Real.exp (a * t) * (a * Real.sin (b * t) - b * Real.cos (b * t)) - Real.exp (a * s) * (a * Real.sin (b * s) - b * Real.cos (b * s))) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
